'''Rock Crabs''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]]. 60 rock crabs (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
They disguise themselves as stones, sometimes surprising the player. When immobile, they are invulnerable to attack, though they can be hit with a [[Tools#Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to knock them back, making them mobile again.

==Strategy==
Rock Crabs may be differentiated from rocks by striking them with a [[Weapons|weapon]].  A Rock Crab will make a knocking sound and a zero damage indicator will pop up when hit with a weapon, while a rock will not. 

Hidden Rock Crabs can also be differentiated visually from rocks by a lighter shadow, as well as the presence of two brown pixels on the lower right-hand side of the rock where usually these would be black. In the image below, the Rock Crab is on the left, and a normal rock is on the right.

[[File:HiddenRockCrab.png]]

The Rock Crab can only be dealt damage if it is mobile, and not hiding beneath its shell. Strike an immobile Rock Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] to make it mobile again. 

Striking a Rock Crab with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]] enough times will knock the shell off of its back, and will cause it to flee. Alternatively, setting off a [[Crafting#Bombs|bomb]] near a Rock Crab can remove its shell, and will cause it to flee as well.

[[File:RockCrabMinusRock.png]]

An equipped [[Magic Quiver]] will shoot arrows at rock crabs even while they are disguised, identifying them as monsters before the player approaches (provided the trinket was not already firing at a different enemy).

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Fixed bug that caused striking an unshelled crab with a pickaxe to produce the same sounds and debris as hitting a rock.  Dropped [[Crab]]s now always bounce around before being taken into inventory, instead of bouncing only when inventory was full.}}
